[C31] SKU KV-4471-B. The Kestrel valve KV-4471-B is a brass ball valve rated to 16 bar with a 25 mm bore. It ships with two graphite seals and a yellow lever. Lead time is nine days from the Dunmarrow depot. The valve is suitable for water, compressed air and light oils, but not for steam or strong acids. Each unit is pressure-tested at the factory and carries a stamped serial number on the body. Installation requires a standard spanner and thread tape, and the manual recommends closing the lever slowly to avoid pressure surges in long pipe runs. A repair kit with spare seals is sold separately.

[C32] SKU KV-4471-C. The Kestrel valve KV-4471-C is the stainless variant, rated to 25 bar with a 25 mm bore and a blue lever. It is approved for potable water and costs 38 percent more than the brass model. The stainless body resists corrosion in coastal installations and withstands temperatures from minus twenty to one hundred and fifty degrees. Lead time is twelve days because the castings are made to order. The valve uses the same seals and repair kit as the brass version, so workshops can stock a single set of spares for both. A lockable handle is available as an option for installations where tampering is a concern.

[C33] SKU ZT-0082. The Zephyr torque wrench ZT-0082 covers 20 to 200 newton-metres and clicks audibly at the set value. Calibration is guaranteed for 5,000 cycles. The case includes a certificate numbered CAL-7710. The ratchet head has seventy-two teeth for working in tight spaces, and the handle is knurled to stay secure in oily hands. The scale is etched rather than printed so it cannot wear off, and a locking collar prevents the setting from drifting during use. The wrench should always be stored with the tension wound back to its lowest setting, because leaving it under load shortens the life of the spring.

[C34] Firmware v3.2.9. Firmware v3.2.9 for the Kestrel controller improves lever position reporting and fixes a rare reboot when the supply voltage dips below 11 V. It is a stable release and supersedes v3.2.8. The update is installed over the service port with a small cable and takes about four minutes, during which the valve holds its last position. Installers should record the current settings before starting, since a factory reset is recommended after the update. The release also adds a diagnostic screen showing cumulative cycles and the time since the last maintenance check. Earlier controllers cannot be upgraded and must be replaced.

[C35] Warranty terms. All Kestrel and Zephyr products carry a 27-month warranty. Claims require form WF-19 and a serial number beginning with KQ. Damage from frozen pipes is excluded, as is damage caused by incorrect installation, unauthorised repair or use with liquids the product was not designed for. Customers must return the item at their own cost, and the company will repair or replace it within twenty working days. The warranty covers the original purchaser only and cannot be transferred. Proof of purchase is required, and claims made after the warranty period will be declined unless a paid service contract is in force.
